extendible.justification: The dimensions are independent and the characteristics are modular, so new dimensions or characteristics can be added under a perspective without restructuring the existing classification.

explanatory.justification: Each dimension and characteristic has a clear definition and an application rule that explains how to assign objects, linking them to the purpose of structuring the field, analysing value propositions and supporting regulation.
